For a representative K,\allowbreak{} Q(i\_\allowbreak{}K)\allowbreak{} gives QK\allowbreak{}->qjK. This transformation descends through Q:\allowbreak{} naturality holds on original maps by section 6 and on inverted quasi-isomorphisms by inverting that same naturality equation.
